data.description: Reside in a tranquil neighborhood that remains conveniently proximate to the city's vibrant energy.

data.answer:
Al Wasl offers a tranquil and peaceful lifestyle, blending modern living with a sense of community. Its diverse range of properties and family-friendly environment make it an attractive choice for those looking to experience the best of Dubai living.

The community is strategically positioned between Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Wasl Road, providing easy access to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Jumeirah. Its central location makes it a sought-after neighborhood for residents who value convenience and connectivity.

The real estate market in Al Wasl Dubai is highly competitive, with properties in high demand due to the community's desirable location and amenities. The area attracts local and expatriate residents, making it a diverse and cosmopolitan neighborhood.

The community offers a mix of residential properties, including villas, townhouses, and apartments. These properties are known for their modern architecture, spacious layouts, and high-quality finishes. Many homes in Al Wasl feature private gardens, swimming pools, and stunning views of the Dubai skyline or the Arabian Gulf.

Popular Communities in Al Wasl Dubai United Arab Emirates

Al Wasl is renowned for its assortment of independent villas and villa compounds, which encompass notable residences such as Al Wasl Villas Compound, Dar Wasl, The Galleria Villas, and the 18 Villa Compound.

Al Wasl Villas Compound offers 3-bedroom villas, while Dar Wasl presents houses in configurations of 4 and 5 bedrooms. The Galleria Villas, another upscale compound, features detached and semi-detached homes with 4 to 5 bedrooms. The 18 Villa Compound by Al Fattan, situated near the Dubai Water Canal, comprises 18 detached villas, each boasting 5 bedrooms.

Al Wasl Properties for Rent

Various complexes in the area offer rental properties, such as Canal Front properties for rent. Al Wasl area rental villas are spacious properties, starting with a minimum of 3 bedrooms. Prices for 3-bedroom Al Wasl villas for rent begin at AED 135k annually, while 4-bedroom Al Wasl villas in Dubai start at AED 130k per year.

Buying A Property in Al Wasl

There are many options available when it comes to Al Wasl properties for sale. You can find 1 to 3-bedroom Al Wasl apartments for purchase and luxury villas. The prices for apartments start from AED 2.6M, whereas villas are available from AED 7.5 M.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in Al Wasl District?

data.answer:
Al Wasl is well-equipped with various amenities to cater to its residents' needs. The community boasts several parks and recreational areas where families can enjoy outdoor activities and picnics. It is also home to various shopping centers, boutiques, and dining options. Popular destinations include City Walk, a contemporary urban lifestyle destination with retail, entertainment, and dining venues.

Public Transportation Near Al Wasl Dubai

Al Wasl's central location ensures excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai. The community is well-served by public transportation, including metro stations and bus routes. Additionally, major highways and roads are easily accessible, facilitating convenient commutes to key business and leisure destinations.

Business Bay Metro Station is about 1 4-minute drive away from the Al Wasl area, while the bus stops within the community are Dewa Al Wasl Customer Happiness Center and Al Wasl 13th Street.

There is also an Etihad Airways bus station in the area. This is a complementary service the airline's passengers can use to travel between Zayed International Airport, Dubai, and Al Ain. 
Burj Khalifa Dubai Mall Metro Station

Supermarkets Near Al Wasl Dubai United Arab Emirates

New Safest Supermarket and Geant Supermarket are premier choices for grocery shopping in the Al Wasl area. Both stores offer a wide range of high-quality products and exceptional services. Choitrams Bay Avenue and Viva Supermarket Mazaya Center are conveniently located nearby.

Shopping Malls in Al Wasl

Key destinations like City Walk provide a blend of luxury and convenience, featuring high-end boutiques, international retail brands, and unique local stores.

Galleria Mall in Al Wasl offers a sophisticated shopping experience with its mix of upscale boutiques, dining options, and entertainment venues. Its elegant design and vibrant atmosphere make it a popular destination for residents and visitors seeking quality retail and leisure activities.

Another popular retail spot in the city, Al Mazaya Center, is located about 5 minutes away from the area.

Schools and Nurseries in Al Wasl

The Al Wasl area boasts a diverse array of reputable schools and nurseries catering to the educational needs of its residents. Great Minds Nursery offers a nurturing environment focusing on early childhood development through engaging and creative learning experiences.

Al Raya Girls School is dedicated to providing high-quality education for young women, emphasizing academic excellence and personal growth. Al Safa High School is also a popular institute in the area.

Dubai Japanese School caters to the Japanese community, offering a curriculum that aligns with Japanese educational standards while embracing cultural integration. Moreover, there is JSS Private School in the area, along with Horizon English School, a famous British school offering a well-rounded education. Moreover, Canadian University campus is located at City Walk.

Churches, Temples And Mosques in and Near Al Wasl Dubai

City Walk Mosque and Abdul Al Rehman Al Qasimi Mosque are in the community. City Walk Mosque is a modern and welcoming place of worship, conveniently located near the bustling shopping and dining destination of City Walk. Abdul Al Rehman Al Qasimi Mosque is also a beautifully designed mosque known for its serene atmosphere and architectural elegance, providing a peaceful space for prayer and reflection in the community.

St. Mary's Catholic Church, located approximately a 15-minute drive away, offers various services and community activities for the Christian faithful. For the Sikh community, the Guru Nanak Darbar Gurudwara in Jebel Ali, about a 30-minute drive from Al Wasl, provides a place for prayer, community gatherings, and langar (free communal meal).

The Hindu Temple Complex in Bur Dubai, which includes several temples dedicated to different deities, is also around a 15-minute drive away, serving as a spiritual and cultural hub for Hindu worshippers. These places of worship ensure that residents of Al Wasl have convenient access to their religious practices and community support.

Clinics And Hospitals in Al Wasl

The Al Wasl area is home to top-tier healthcare facilities such as Al Ittihad Health Center and Valiant Clinic and Hospital, both renowned for their exceptional medical services and patient care. Al Ittihad Health Center provides comprehensive healthcare services, including general medicine, pediatrics, and specialized treatments, ensuring accessible and quality care for the community.

Valiant Clinic and Hospital, known for its state-of-the-art facilities and expert medical staff, offers various services, preventive care and diagnostics to advanced treatments and surgeries. Both institutions are committed to delivering personalized and efficient healthcare, making Al Wasl a prime location for residents seeking top-notch medical care.

Al Wasl Location And Nearby Areas

Al Wasl Dubai is centrally located, nestled between the bustling districts of Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah. This prime location provides easy access to key areas such as Business Bay, DIFC, and Sheikh Zayed Road, making it convenient for both residential and commercial purposes.

Nearby, residents can enjoy the vibrant offerings of City Walk, the serene beaches of Jumeirah, and the cultural attractions of the Al Fahidi Historical Neighborhood. The area’s strategic position ensures a blend of urban convenience and coastal tranquility, making it a highly sought-after location in the city.

more_info.question: Things To Do in Al Wasl

data.answer:
The community is home to popular Meraas projects in Dubai, such as BoxPark and City Walk, as well as the high-fashion shopping destination Galleria Mall. All these amenities make the area a fun place to be.

Restaurants in Al Wasl Dubai

Al Wasl is a culinary hotspot, featuring an array of dining options to satisfy diverse tastes. The Pit Dubai House of Barbeque stands out for its mouth-watering smoked meats and classic BBQ dishes, offering a hearty dining experience.

In addition to The Pit, Al Wasl boasts numerous restaurants, especially in the vibrant City Walk area. At Al Wasl area restaurants, visitors can explore a variety of cuisines, from the Italian delights at Sapori Di Bice to the contemporary Asian flavors at Meraas’ Farzi Café. Le Pain Quotidien offers a charming spot for organic bakery items and healthy meals, while Cocoa Kitchen is a haven for chocolate lovers. This eclectic mix of eateries makes Al Wasl a premier gastronomic destination for both residents and visitors.

Beaches Near Al Wasl

Al Wasl residents and visitors can enjoy easy access to some of Dubai's finest beaches, offering a perfect escape for relaxation and recreation. Jumeirah Beach, just a short drive away, is a popular spot known for its pristine sands, clear waters, and vibrant promenade with cafes, restaurants, and shops. Kite Beach is another nearby favorite, attracting water sports enthusiasts and families alike with its extensive facilities, including food trucks, play areas, and jogging tracks.

Hotels in Al Wasl Dubai

Al Wasl is home to a variety of high-quality hotels that cater to different preferences and budgets, enhancing the area's appeal for both tourists and business travelers. Among them, Rove City Walk stands out for its modern design, excellent amenities, and convenient location near the bustling City Walk district. This hotel offers comfortable accommodations with a trendy, urban vibe, perfect for those looking to explore the city's attractions.

Additionally, Al Wasl hosts other notable hotels such as La Ville Hotel & Suites, which offers luxurious accommodations and stunning views, and Al Khoory Executive Hotel, known for its affordability and excellent service. These hotels provide a range of options for visitors, ensuring a pleasant and memorable stay in the heart of Dubai.

Al Wasl Area Location and Nearby Communities

Al Wasl is centrally located in Dubai, offering residents convenient access to several prominent areas. It is bordered by the upscale beachfront neighborhood of Jumeirah, the residential district of Al Safa, and the dynamic urban hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. Additionally, the bustling area of Satwa is nearby, known for its vibrant street life and diverse shopping options. This strategic location provides Al Wasl residents with a blend of serene residential living and easy access to Dubai’s key commercial, retail, and leisure destinations.

Attractions in Al Wasl Dubai

Al Wasl is a vibrant area in Dubai, home to a variety of attractions that cater to diverse interests. BoxPark offers a unique shopping and dining experience with its trendy, urban design and eclectic mix of stores and eateries. City Walk is a major attraction, featuring high-end boutiques, gourmet restaurants, and entertainment options, including the Coca-Cola Arena, which hosts concerts, sports events, and live performances.

Galleria Mall provides a sophisticated shopping environment with upscale retail outlets and dining venues. Nature enthusiasts can explore The Green Planet, a biodome that recreates a tropical rainforest environment, housing over 3,000 plants and animals. These attractions make Al Wasl a dynamic and engaging destination for both residents and visitors.

Outdoor Activities and Fitness Facilities

Residents can enjoy strolls or picnics in the area's well-maintained parks, such as Safa Park, which features lush greenery, jogging tracks, and scenic picnic spots. The vibrant City Walk area also offers outdoor dining and shopping experiences, along with public art displays and interactive play areas for children. These outdoor options make Al Wasl area location ideal for enjoying Dubai's sunny weather and active lifestyle.

Snob Beauty Salon, The Salon Dubai, and Essential Beauty Salon are all located in Al Wasl. When it comes to fitness centers, there are 51 Gym, Fitness First, and Warehouse Gym in the vicinity.

One disadvantage of living in Al Wasl is the potential for traffic congestion, particularly during peak hours. Its central location, while convenient for accessing various parts of Dubai, can also lead to busy roads and increased travel times, especially on main thoroughfares like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Wasl Road.

What are the popular attractions in Al Wasl?

Al Wasl, a vibrant area in Dubai, offers a mix of attractions for residents and visitors alike. From the trendy City Walk and the indoor tropical rainforest at The Green Planet to the picturesque Dubai Canal and the serene Safa Park, there's something for everyone.

Al Wasl is home to a variety of dining options, ranging from local eateries to international chains. Some popular choices include Baker & Spice for organic food, La Serre Bistro & Boulangerie for French cuisine, Tom&Serg for a trendy cafe experience, and Bu Qtair for delicious seafood.

The property prices in Al Wasl can vary depending on the type and size of the property. As of my last update, the average price for villas in Al Wasl ranged from AED 2.5 million to AED 15 million, while apartments ranged from AED 1.5 million to AED 5 million.

Al Wasl is primarily a residential area with a mix of villas and apartments. Some of the popular residential communities within Al Wasl include Al Badaa, Al Safa, and Jumeirah. These communities offer a range of amenities and are well-connected to the rest of Dubai, making them attractive options for residents.

Who is the owner of Al Wasl Dubai?
Al Wasl is not owned by a single entity; it is a neighborhood within Dubai managed and developed by various real estate developers and authorities under the jurisdiction of the Dubai government.

Is Al Wasl the old name of Dubai?

No, Al Wasl is not the old name of Dubai. Al Wasl is a specific area within Dubai. The historical name "Al Wasl" was used to refer to the broader region encompassing what is now modern Dubai.

Is Al Wasl a good place to live?

Yes, Al Wasl is considered a good place to live due to its central location, proximity to key areas like Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah, and its abundance of amenities, including parks, schools, shopping centers, and dining options. It offers a blend of residential tranquility and urban convenience, making it a desirable neighborhood for many residents.

nodes.title: Amali Residences
nodes.about:
Amali Residences Dubai Canal rises in Al Wasl as a striking 48-floor landmark overlooking the Dubai Water Canal. Developed by Amali Properties, the tower presents 2, 3 and 4-bedroom apartments alongside 5 and 6-bedroom penthouses and exclusive 4 and 5-bedroom villas.

Amali Residences by Amali Properties reflects a new era of ultra-refined waterfront living, pairing curated architecture with resort-inspired experiences. With indoor and outdoor pools, a gym and strength studio, yoga and Pilates facilities, and a dedicated kid’s waterpark, the development is positioned for high capital appreciation in one of Dubai’s most prestigious corridors.

nodes.title: Muraba Veil
nodes.about:
Muraba Veil, Dubai Canal, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, is set to transform Dubai’s skyline with its extraordinary design, becoming the second-thinnest skyscraper in the world. Standing at an impressive height of 1,247 feet but only 74 feet wide, it redefines luxury living with a slender silhouette that houses a single apartment per floor. The exterior is wrapped in a custom-designed stainless steel “veil” that not only enhances the building’s sleek, modern look but also serves as a functional feature to optimize privacy while allowing natural light to flood the interiors. This innovative facade captures the changing colors of the sky, creating a dynamic, ever-evolving visual experience.

Strategically located along Sheikh Zayed Road and overlooking the Dubai Canal, Muraba Veil at Al Wasl by Muraba Properties offers a collection of 131 luxurious apartments with two to five bedrooms. Inspired by traditional Arabian architecture, the residences are arranged around internal courtyards enriched with greenery, providing a serene retreat in the heart of the city. The project includes exclusive amenities such as a spa, a private movie theater, a gallery, a restaurant, and even a padel court, ensuring a holistic lifestyle that blends culture, luxury, and modern convenience.
